# Temple Scroll Column 63 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 63 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**63:1** You shall investigate thoroughly, inquiring with diligence. If indeed the matter is true and established — the abomination has been committed in your midst —

**63:2** you shall put the inhabitants of that city to the sword without fail. You shall devote it to utter destruction — the city, all who are in it, and its livestock — by the sword.

**63:3** All its spoil you shall gather into the center of its public square, and you shall burn the city and all its spoil entirely with fire before me.

**63:4** It shall remain a permanent ruin, never to be rebuilt. Nothing from the devoted things shall remain in your possession,

**63:5** so that I may turn from the fierceness of my anger and show you mercy, having compassion on you and multiplying you, as I swore to your fathers,

**63:6** because you obeyed my voice and kept all my commandments that I am commanding you today, doing what is right in my sight.

**63:7** You shall not sacrifice to me an ox or a sheep that has any blemish or defect whatever, for that is an abomination to me.

**63:8** You shall not eat anything abominable. These are the animals you may eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,

**63:9** the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the mountain sheep.

**63:10** Any animal that has a divided hoof, split into two parts, and that chews the cud — such animals you may eat.

**63:11** You shall tithe without fail all the produce of your seed from the field each year.

**63:12** You shall eat before me, in the place I shall choose to establish my name, the tithe of your grain, your new wine, and your oil,

**63:13** together with the firstborn of your herds and flocks, so that you may learn to revere me always.

**63:14** If the distance is too great for you to carry it, because the place I shall choose to set my name is far from you,

**63:15** when I bless you, then you shall convert it to silver, take the silver in hand, and go to the place I shall choose.

**63:16** You shall spend the silver on whatever you desire — oxen, sheep, wine, strong drink, or anything you wish — and you shall eat there before me and rejoice, you and your household.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Council followed LOGOS as baseline throughout. "Devote to utter destruction" preserves the חרם concept better than PNEUMA's "completely destroy." "Strong drink" retained over PNEUMA's "beer" — שכר covers a broader category. "Revere" (LOGOS) preferred over "fear" (EMET) and "honor" (PNEUMA) for ירא in this context. Clean animal list follows all three translators identically. First-person divine speech maintained throughout.*
